chapter: Clarifications and portraits: Lester Young, Byas, Blanton, Ben Webster
title: Heckling Art Tatum at the Club Alabam breakfast club jam sessions
summary: After-hours jam sessions with Tatum, Byas, Barefield and Al Morgan; Tatum would leave when he took the bass.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: And you mentioned when you played with Art Tatum, Roy Eldridge took you to his gig in Chicago. And that Art Tatum knew you and your playing. He didn't even have to look up when he heard you --
-- when did Art Tatum get to know you? In Los Angeles?
You played with him in Los Angeles?
No, I heckled him in Los Angeles. Yes, (laughter).
When did he hear your playing?

After hours at the Club Alabam, Breakfast Club upstairs. Art Tatum, Don Byas, Eddie Barefield, Al Morgan. We'd jam up there every morning. And Al Morgan being slow, I'd always run and grab the bass. He couldn't be found, I'd grab the bass. Band start to playing, I pulled the first note, Tatum get up (laughter), there'll be a slight intermission.
That was during your first stint in Los Angeles?
